lines.text: Okay, Infosys. At the Australian Open, you brought a robot to the Fan Zone.
I brought mine to Deakin Open Day
two separate uni projects, backend API and a robot, nothing said they should meet, so I made them meet
lines.action: fists out wide, fists together on meet, both hands up and look up, hold 1 s

lines.text: unit chair said I might finish neither, and for a month he was right
then it worked, 100 out of 100, picked for Open Day
that's why MatchFeel got me, nobody expects to follow tennis by touch, you built it anyway
same with my robot, nobody asked me for it, I built it anyway
that's the work I want at InStep, AI and robots that leave the screen
I haven't trained an ML model yet, that's what I want your mentors for
So yeah, I'm Manit Khera. I usually end up doing more than the brief asks. Thanks for watching.
